targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count() AS runs FROM agent_runs_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY status

SELECT run_id, sumOrNull(input) AS input, sumOrNull(output) AS output, sumOrNull(cache_read) AS cache_read, sumOrNull(cache_write) AS cache_write, sumOrNull(cache_write_1h) AS cache_write_1h, sumOrNull(reasoning) AS reasoning_subset, sumOrNull(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sumOrNull(cost_total) AS cost_usd FROM agent_usage_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
SELECT tool, phase, count() AS events, sum(is_error) AS errors FROM agent_tool_calls_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY tool, phase
SELECT run_id, status, capture_complete FROM agent_runs_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at DESC
SELECT run_id, user_id, verdict FROM agent_feedback_current
SELECT run_id, tool_call_id, parser, status, passed, failed FROM agent_test_results_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at DESC

SELECT run_id, model, reasoning_effort, JSONExtractString(routing_json, 'source') AS routing_mode, JSONExtractString(routing_json, 'recommendedModelRef') AS recommendation, if(JSONHas(routing_json, 'probability'), JSONExtractFloat(routing_json, 'probability'), NULL) AS probability, if(JSONHas(routing_json, 'jevCostUsd'), JSONExtractFloat(routing_json, 'jevCostUsd'), NULL) AS routing_cost_usd FROM agent_runs_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)

SELECT SpanName, count() AS spans, quantile(0.5)(Duration/1e6) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(Duration/1e6) AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, any(SpanName) AS SpanName, any(Duration) AS Duration FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY TraceId, SpanId) GROUP BY SpanName

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'type') AS event_type, count() AS events FROM agent_events_latest WHERE kind='rpc' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND event_type IN ('auto_retry_start', 'auto_retry_end', 'auto_compaction_start', 'auto_compaction_end') GROUP BY event_type

SELECT min(Timestamp) AS first_seen, TraceId, SpanId, any(ParentSpanId) AS ParentSpanId, any(SpanName) AS SpanName, any(Duration)/1e6 AS duration_ms, any(StatusCode) AS StatusCode FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND (${run_id:sqlstring}='' OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['agent.run_id']=${run_id:sqlstring})) GROUP BY TraceId, SpanId ORDER BY first_seen

panels.title: Raw dialogue and tool payload references

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at, run_id, event_id, kind, payload_json FROM agent_events_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND (${run_id:sqlstring}='' OR run_id=${run_id:sqlstring}) AND kind IN ('session_entry', 'bash_output_manifest', 'capture_status') ORDER BY collected_at LIMIT 200

SELECT collected_at, run_id, phase, payload_json FROM agent_session_stats_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND (${run_id:sqlstring}='' OR run_id=${run_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY collected_at LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM agent_usage_reconciliation

panels.title: Workflow execution accounting
panels.description: Stage spans may overlap; never sum child durations to infer wall time. Cost estimates are separate from official Pi usage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM agent_workflow_usage

panels.title: Candidate verification and independent grades
panels.description: Stage spans may overlap; never sum child durations to infer wall time. Cost estimates are separate from official Pi usage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.run_id, v.attempt, v.candidate_hash, v.status AS verification_status, g.status AS grader_status FROM agent_verifications_latest v LEFT JOIN agent_grades_latest g ON v.run_id=g.run_id AND v.attempt=g.attempt AND v.candidate_hash=g.candidate_hash WHERE $__timeFilter(v.collected_at) ORDER BY v.collected_at DESC

panels.title: Wall time, active time and human waiting
panels.description: Stage spans may overlap; never sum child durations to infer wall time. Cost estimates are separate from official Pi usage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id, JSONExtractInt(payload_json,'timing','wall_ms') AS wall_ms, JSONExtractInt(payload_json,'timing','active_ms') AS active_ms, JSONExtractInt(payload_json,'timing','human_wait_ms') AS human_wait_ms FROM agent_runs_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)

panels.title: Gateway reservations (token-based estimates)
panels.description: Stage spans may overlap; never sum child durations to infer wall time. Cost estimates are separate from official Pi usage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at, run_id, payload_json FROM agent_events_latest WHERE kind='budget' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at DESC

panels.title: Structured workflow nodes
panels.description: Parallel agent intervals overlap. Investigation agent time excludes container admission queues; inspect the trace waterfall for writer, verifier and grader intervals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT workflow_run_id,node_id,any(role) AS role,max(wave) AS wave,max(attempt) AS attempts,argMax(state,version) AS state,argMax(duration_ms,version) AS last_attempt_ms,argMax(queue_ms,version) AS queue_ms FROM agent_workflow_nodes_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY workflow_run_id,node_id ORDER BY workflow_run_id,node_id

panels.title: Workflow revisions and dependencies
panels.description: Parallel agent intervals overlap. Investigation agent time excludes container admission queues; inspect the trace waterfall for writer, verifier and grader intervals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at,run_id,kind,payload_json FROM agent_events_latest WHERE kind IN ('workflow_revision','workflow_dependency') AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at DESC

panels.title: Structured workflow wall time versus agent work
panels.description: Parallel agent intervals overlap. Investigation agent time excludes container admission queues; inspect the trace waterfall for writer, verifier and grader intervals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'timing','wall_ms') AS wall_ms,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'timing','active_ms') AS active_ms,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'timing','human_wait_ms') AS human_wait_ms,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'suspended_ms') AS suspended_ms,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'workflow_summary','agent_work_ms') AS investigation_agent_ms,JSONExtractUInt(payload_json,'workflow_summary','queue_ms') AS investigation_queue_ms FROM agent_runs_latest WHERE JSONExtractString(payload_json,'workflow_mode')='structured' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at DESC

panels.title: All agent roles: cumulative work and queue time

targets.rawSql: SELECT workflow_run_id,role,count() AS executions,sum(active_agent_ms) AS known_agent_work_ms,sum(queue_ms) AS known_queue_ms,countIf(isNull(active_agent_ms)) AS incomplete_executions FROM agent_workflow_execution_durations GROUP BY workflow_run_id,role ORDER BY workflow_run_id,role

SELECT prompts_version,count() AS feedback,countIf(agrees=1) AS agree,countIf(agrees=0) AS disagree,countIf(isNull(agrees)) AS no_grader_verdict,if(countIf(isNotNull(agrees))>0,countIf(agrees=1)/countIf(isNotNull(agrees)),NULL) AS agreement_rate,countIf(grade_status='passed' AND feedback_verdict='needs_changes') AS grader_passed_owner_rejected,countIf(grade_status='needs_changes' AND feedback_verdict='accepted') AS grader_failed_owner_accepted FROM agent_grade_feedback_agreement GROUP BY prompts_version ORDER BY prompts_version
